key: Mama|Hush, child. Tonight we walk.
text: Hush, child. Tonight we walk.

key: Mama|Up to the mountains. To people who live free.
text: Up to the mountains. To people who live free.
spoken: Up to the mountains. To people who live free.

key: Mama|Here we are enslaved. We are forced to work.
text: Here we are enslaved. We are forced to work.
spoken: Here we are enslaved. We are forced to work.

key: Mama|We are not free to leave. So we go at night.
text: We are not free to leave. So we go at night.
spoken: We are not free to leave. So we go at night.

key: Mama|Stay close to me. Stay quiet.
text: Stay close to me. Stay quiet.
spoken: Stay close to me. Stay quiet.

key: Quamin|I am Quamin. I come from the hill town.
text: I am Quamin. I come from the hill town.
spoken: I am Quamin. I come from the hill town.

key: Quamin|It is a long, steep walk. I know the way.
text: It is a long, steep walk. I know the way.
spoken: It is a long, steep walk. I know the way.

key: Quamin|My people are called Maroons.
text: My people are called Maroons.
spoken: My people are called Maroons.

key: Quamin|A watchman walks the cart road with a lantern.
text: A watchman walks the cart road with a lantern.
spoken: A watchman walks the cart road with a lantern.

key: Quamin|When his light comes near, wait in the dark.
text: When his light comes near, wait in the dark.
spoken: When his light comes near, wait in the dark.

key: Quamin|Follow me. Walk where I walk.
text: Follow me. Walk where I walk.
spoken: Follow me. Walk where I walk.

key: Quamin|Look. Morning is coming.
text: Look. Morning is coming.
spoken: Look. Morning is coming.

key: Quamin|Those are the Blue Mountains.
text: Those are the Blue Mountains.
spoken: Those are the Blue Mountains.

key: Quamin|High and steep. That keeps us safe.
text: High and steep. That keeps us safe.
spoken: High and steep. That keeps us safe.

key: Quamin|Hear that horn? They know we are coming.
text: Hear that horn? They know we are coming.
spoken: Hear that horn? They know we are coming.

key: Auntie Mimba|Welcome, child. You walked a long way.
text: Welcome, child. You walked a long way.
spoken: Welcome, child. You walked a long way.

key: Auntie Mimba|This is Nanny Town.
text: This is Nanny Town.
spoken: This is Nanny Town.

key: Auntie Mimba|More than one hundred and forty.
text: More than one hundred and forty.
spoken: More than one hundred and forty.

key: Auntie Mimba|Here nobody owns you. Here everybody works.
text: Here nobody owns you. Here everybody works.
spoken: Here nobody owns you. Here everybody works.

key: Auntie Mimba|Come and help me plant, later.
text: Come and help me plant, later.
spoken: Come and help me plant, later.

key: Cubbenah|You climbed the path. Good legs!
text: You climbed the path. Good legs!
spoken: You climbed the path. Good legs!

key: Cubbenah|Two people cannot walk it side by side.
text: Two people cannot walk it side by side.
spoken: Two people cannot walk it side by side.

key: Cubbenah|That is why the town is here.
text: That is why the town is here.
spoken: That is why the town is here.

key: Cubbenah|I keep the horn. I will teach you.
text: I keep the horn. I will teach you.
spoken: I keep the horn. I will teach you.

key: Beneba|Are you new? I am Beneba.
text: Are you new? I am Beneba.
spoken: Are you new? I am Beneba.

key: Beneba|I was born on a Tuesday. That is my name.
text: I was born on a Tuesday. That is my name.
spoken: I was born on a Tuesday. That is my name.

key: Beneba|I will show you everything!
text: I will show you everything!
spoken: I will show you everything!

key: Beneba|The gardens, the big cotton tree, the high rock.
text: The gardens, the big cotton tree, the high rock.
spoken: The gardens, the big cotton tree, the high rock.

key: Auntie Mimba|Good work. Yams feed us for many months.
text: Good work. Yams feed us for many months.
spoken: Good work. Yams feed us for many months.

key: Auntie Mimba|We grow plantains too. The hunters bring wild hog.
text: We grow plantains too. The hunters bring wild hog.
spoken: We grow plantains too. The hunters bring wild hog.

key: Auntie Mimba|Now go and find Cubbenah. He has the horn.
text: Now go and find Cubbenah. He has the horn.
spoken: Now go and find Cubbenah. He has the horn.

key: Cubbenah|Well blown! The horn talks across the valleys.
text: Well blown! The horn talks across the valleys.
spoken: Well blown! The horn talks across the valleys.

key: Cubbenah|Our lookouts use it to warn the town.
text: Our lookouts use it to warn the town.
spoken: Our lookouts use it to warn the town.

key: Cubbenah|Look up there. On the high rock.
text: Look up there. On the high rock.
spoken: Look up there. On the high rock.

key: Auntie Mimba|That was Nanny. She leads this town.
text: That was Nanny. She leads this town.
spoken: That was Nanny. She leads this town.

key: Auntie Mimba|We trust her. She keeps us free.
text: We trust her. She keeps us free.
spoken: We trust her. She keeps us free.

key: Auntie Mimba|In this town, everyone has work.
text: In this town, everyone has work.
spoken: In this town, everyone has work.

key: Auntie Mimba|What work would you like, child?
text: What work would you like, child?
spoken: What work would you like, child?

key: Auntie Mimba|Good. Sharp eyes keep us safe.
text: Good. Sharp eyes keep us safe.
spoken: Good. Sharp eyes keep us safe.

key: Auntie Mimba|Good. Full bellies keep us strong.
text: Good. Full bellies keep us strong.
spoken: Good. Full bellies keep us strong.

key: Auntie Mimba|Good. Quick feet keep us together.
text: Good. Quick feet keep us together.
spoken: Good. Quick feet keep us together.

key: Quamin|From here we see the whole valley.
text: From here we see the whole valley.
spoken: From here we see the whole valley.

key: Quamin|Our lookouts sit far below, by the trails.
text: Our lookouts sit far below, by the trails.
spoken: Our lookouts sit far below, by the trails.

key: Quamin|They give us hours of warning.
text: They give us hours of warning.
spoken: They give us hours of warning.

key: Quamin|Soldiers. They have come before.
text: Soldiers. They have come before.
spoken: Soldiers. They have come before.

key: Cubbenah|Keep the horn ready, little one.
text: Keep the horn ready, little one.
spoken: Keep the horn ready, little one.

key: Cubbenah|If a call comes, we pass it on.
text: If a call comes, we pass it on.
spoken: If a call comes, we pass it on.

key: Cubbenah|Go to the edge. Look out over the valley.
text: Go to the edge. Look out over the valley.
spoken: Go to the edge. Look out over the valley.

key: Cubbenah|Hear them? The whole mountain knows now.
text: Hear them? The whole mountain knows now.
spoken: Hear them? The whole mountain knows now.

key: Cubbenah|The soldiers are still hours away.
text: The soldiers are still hours away.
spoken: The soldiers are still hours away.

key: Cubbenah|Take forked sticks down to the trenches.
text: Take forked sticks down to the trenches.
spoken: Take forked sticks down to the trenches.

key: Mama|The little ones and the elders go up the back trail.
text: The little ones and the elders go up the back trail.
spoken: The little ones and the elders go up the back trail.

key: Mama|I will go with them.
text: I will go with them.
spoken: I will go with them.

key: Mama|Then stay behind the rock. Stay low.
text: Then stay behind the rock. Stay low.
spoken: Then stay behind the rock. Stay low.

key: Mama|Here. Put on this cloak of leaves.
text: Here. Put on this cloak of leaves.
spoken: Here. Put on this cloak of leaves.

key: Cubbenah|They are on the path now.
text: They are on the path now.
spoken: They are on the path now.

key: Cubbenah|Do not be afraid. We know this mountain.
text: Do not be afraid. We know this mountain.
spoken: Do not be afraid. We know this mountain.

key: Cubbenah|When I nod, blow the call.
text: When I nod, blow the call.
spoken: When I nod, blow the call.

key: Cubbenah|They have gone back down the mountain.
text: They have gone back down the mountain.
spoken: They have gone back down the mountain.

key: Cubbenah|You blew that horn well.
text: You blew that horn well.
spoken: You blew that horn well.

key: Cubbenah|Yes. They will come again.
text: Yes. They will come again.
spoken: Yes. They will come again.

key: Mama|You are safe! Let me look at you.
text: You are safe! Let me look at you.
spoken: You are safe! Let me look at you.

key: Mama|Today nobody in our town was lost.
text: Today nobody in our town was lost.
spoken: Today nobody in our town was lost.

key: Mama|It is not always so, child.
text: It is not always so, child.
spoken: It is not always so, child.

key: Mama|Wake up, child! The horn!
text: Wake up, child! The horn!
spoken: Wake up, child! The horn!

key: Mama|Soldiers are on the path. Very many.
text: Soldiers are on the path. Very many.
spoken: Soldiers are on the path. Very many.

key: Mama|This time they carry small cannon.
text: This time they carry small cannon.
spoken: This time they carry small cannon.

key: Mama|We leave. A town is its people.
text: We leave. A town is its people.
spoken: We leave. A town is its people.

key: Mama|Wake the houses on our row. Quickly!
text: Wake the houses on our row. Quickly!
spoken: Wake the houses on our row. Quickly!

key: Beneba|I cannot find Phibba! My little sister!
text: I cannot find Phibba! My little sister!
spoken: I cannot find Phibba! My little sister!

key: Beneba|She hides by the cotton tree when she is scared.
text: She hides by the cotton tree when she is scared.
spoken: She hides by the cotton tree when she is scared.

key: Phibba|The noise is too big.
text: The noise is too big.
spoken: The noise is too big.

key: Phibba|Will you stay with me?
text: Will you stay with me?
spoken: Will you stay with me?

key: Mama|Look back, child. Only once.
text: Look back, child. Only once.
spoken: Look back, child. Only once.

key: Mama|Houses can be built again.
text: Houses can be built again.
spoken: Houses can be built again.

key: Mama|We are alive. We are together.
text: We are alive. We are together.
spoken: We are alive. We are together.

key: Mama|Deeper into the mountains. Then we build.
text: Deeper into the mountains. Then we build.
spoken: Deeper into the mountains. Then we build.

key: Mama|Six years since the old town. You have grown!
text: Six years since the old town. You have grown!
spoken: Six years since the old town. You have grown!

key: Mama|We built again, here by the river.
text: We built again, here by the river.
spoken: We built again, here by the river.

key: Mama|Yes. Peace was made last year.
text: Yes. Peace was made last year.
spoken: Yes. Peace was made last year.

text: Now my horn calls people to meet.
spoken: Now my horn calls people to meet.

key: Cubbenah|The peace has rules. Some are hard.
text: The peace has rules. Some are hard.
spoken: The peace has rules. Some are hard.

key: Cubbenah|We must send back people who escape to us.
text: We must send back people who escape to us.
spoken: We must send back people who escape to us.

key: Cubbenah|They are taken back to the estates.
text: They are taken back to the estates.
spoken: They are taken back to the estates.

key: Cubbenah|It is a hard rule. People still argue about it.
text: It is a hard rule. People still argue about it.
spoken: It is a hard rule. People still argue about it.

key: Beneba|Phibba is taller than me now!
text: Phibba is taller than me now!
spoken: Phibba is taller than me now!

key: Beneba|A paper has come. It has Nanny’s name on it.
text: A paper has come. It has Nanny’s name on it.
spoken: A paper has come. It has Nanny's name on it.

key: Beneba|It lies on the flat stone. Come and see.
text: It lies on the flat stone. Come and see.
spoken: It lies on the flat stone. Come and see.

key: Beneba|Let us play a game. How do we know things?
text: Let us play a game. How do we know things?
spoken: Let us play a game. How do we know things?

key: Beneba|Good! Now you know how to ask.
text: Good! Now you know how to ask.
